generation_execution: strictly serial, one asset per call, no Godot runs
source_policy: Self-generated art. Existing project cover/splash images inspected as references; no downloaded third-party assets.

processing.alpha: Native generated RGBA, no chroma key. Alpha <=16 set to 0 to remove faint stray colored pixels. Alpha >=245 set to 255 to make nearly-opaque interiors opaque; intermediate edge alpha retained. Zero-alpha RGB cleared.
processing.trim: Crop to resulting alpha bounding box (per-piece coordinates retained).
processing.frame_resize: Nine-region Lanczos resampling: equal source slice margins map to equal final slice margins on all four sides; corners resize uniformly, center/edge strips stretch. No painted geometry replacement, mirroring, color grading, or procedural ornament added.
processing.divider_resize: Aspect-preserving thumbnail of trimmed art into 508x44, centered on transparent 512x48 canvas.
processing.border_definition: The listed border is the EXACT protected nine-slice margin, including corner ornaments and a small quiet guard band. It is not a claim that every painted metal pixel fills that entire margin. Brush/antialias edges naturally vary slightly.
processing.reproducibility: processing_metrics.json retains native dimensions, crop rectangles, source and destination slice margins and final hashes.

panel.visual_review: Accepted after viewing generated master and final dark/mid-background contact sheet; painterly warm materials, coherent mirrored corner forms, straight consistent rails and quiet center.

stretch_contract.reason: One conventional nine-slice cannot preserve both endcaps and an ornament in its stretchable center. Keep center fixed and stretch the two undecorated rails independently.

verification.green_predicate: alpha>0 and G>max(R,B)+20; checked on all visible final pixels (stricter than just rim)

limitations: Divider is not suitable for ordinary single-nine-slice width expansion with its central ornament preserved. Its exact five horizontal atlas regions are specified above.
Actual in-game display sizes and import behavior were not verified; exports are intended as 2x assets at the listed base draw sizes.
Weakest piece: slot has extra tiny corner facets; these soften at 48-96px display and are less restrained than the card. Palette remains neutral bronze.
